bio: Located in Kusel's old town centre, right on the market square, this renovated townhouse is certainly charming. Out front, there are a few trees and a fountain – the terrace seating here is delightful in summer. The place has a modern feel and a laid-back, friendly atmosphere. Wooden ceiling beams and exposed old sandstone masonry hark back to a bygone era. Ulrike und Daniel Bößhar delight diners with attentive service and ambitious cuisine in the form of a modern inspired set menu with three to seven courses....
